positions.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 1999 IPO prospectus bio: co-founded the Company 'in April 1993' and President and CEO 'since its inception'; company incorporated April 1993
positions.notes: Founder; also a director since inception (board file). No day is disclosed. 10-K rosters through FY2018 read 'President, Chief Executive Officer and Director'. Still President and CEO on the FY2026 10-K roster (2026-02-20) and his 2026-09-16 Form 4; no Item 5.02 change through 2026-09-23.

positions.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 2014 proxy: 'Ms. Kress became our CFO on September 30, 2013'; Form 3 event date 2013-09-30; 8-K Item 5.02 (2013-09-16): appointed 2013-09-11, effective on her employment start
positions.notes: Also principal financial officer. Succeeded interim CFO Karen Burns (interim until 2013-09-29). Current as of the FY2026 10-K roster (2026-02-20) and her 2026-09-16 Form 4; no Item 5.02 change through 2026-09-23.

positions.title: Senior Vice President, Worldwide Sales
positions.start_date_basis: Form 3 date of event 2005-12-22 (officer title 'VP, Worldwide Sales'); 10-K bios: joined 'in December 2005 as Senior Vice President, Worldwide Sales'
positions.notes: Pre-2019 role. On the executive officer roster as of 2006-01-29 (FY2006 10-K). No 8-K for his hire. His Form 3 and Form 4s through 2008 give the title as 'VP, Worldwide Sales'; the 10-Ks say Senior Vice President (see conflicts).

positions.title: Executive Vice President, Worldwide Sales
positions.start_date_basis: FY2011 10-K bio: 'became Executive Vice President, Worldwide Sales in January 2009'
positions.notes: The role was renamed Worldwide Field Operations in 2014: his Form 4s say 'EVP, Worldwide Sales' through 2014-05-29 and 'EVP, Worldwide Field Ops' from 2014-09-17, so the change falls between those dates (year precision; see open questions). The FY2014 10-K roster (2014-03-07) still says Worldwide Sales.

positions.title: Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations
positions.start_date_basis: FY2015 10-K: EVP Worldwide Sales 'subsequently renamed to Worldwide Field Operations'; Form 4 officer title changes between 2014-05-29 and 2014-09-17
positions.notes: Start is the 2014 rename (exact day unknown). Retirement announced in the 2026-07-02 8-K (he notified the company 2026-06-28), effective when his successor Nicholas Parker started; Parker's Form 3 event date and Puri's own Form 4 remark both give 2026-08-24. He stays with NVIDIA in a senior advisory role (not an officer); no employment end date has been disclosed.

positions.title: Senior Vice President, Operations
positions.start_date_basis: Form 3 date of event 2007-09-17 (officer title 'Senior VP, Operations'); 10-K bios: joined 'in September 2007 as Senior Vice President of Operations'
positions.notes: Pre-2019 role. No 8-K for her hire; the Form 3 event date is the earliest day-level evidence. On the executive officer roster as of 2008-01-27 (FY2008 10-K).

positions.title: Executive Vice President, Operations
positions.start_date_basis: FY2011 10-K bio: 'became Executive Vice President of Operations in January 2009'
positions.notes: Her remit later grew (Facilities 2013, IT 2015 per the FY2016 and FY2017 10-Ks) with no title change. Current as of the FY2026 10-K roster (2026-02-20) and her 2026-09-16 Form 4; no Item 5.02 change through 2026-09-23.

positions.title: Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary
positions.start_date_basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (2017-01-19): appointed effective on his employment start 'expected on January 23, 2017'; Form 3 event date 2017-01-23
positions.notes: Took over the legal function from David M. Shannon (Chief Administrative Officer, who retired).

positions.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary
positions.start_date_basis: 2019 proxy SCT footnote (6) and FY2026 10-K bio: became EVP, General Counsel and Secretary 'in February 2018'

conflicts.description: Puri's title at hire: his Form 3 (2005-12-22) and Form 4s through September 2008 give 'VP, Worldwide Sales', while every 10-K roster and bio says Senior Vice President, Worldwide Sales. The 10-K title is recorded.

Puri's Worldwide Field Operations title: the FY2015 and FY2016 10-Ks say his EVP, Worldwide Sales role (January 2009) was 'subsequently renamed', and later 10-Ks simply say he became EVP, Worldwide Field Operations 'in 2009'. The FY2014 roster (2014-03-07) and his Form 4s through 2014-05-29 still say Worldwide Sales; the new title first appears on his 2014-09-17 Form 4. Recorded as two positions split in 2014.

Teter's title: 10-K rosters from FY2019 on list 'Executive Vice President and General Counsel', while the proxy SCTs (2019-2026) list 'Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary', he signs the 2026 proxy notice as Secretary, and his 2026-09-21 Form 4 title is 'EVP, General Counsel and Sec'. Recorded as EVP, General Counsel and Secretary.

PvP TSR base change: the 2023-2025 proxies measure cumulative TSR from 2020-01-24, the 2026 proxy from 2021-01-29, so the same years carry different values. NVIDIA TSR for FY2022 / FY2023 / FY2024 / FY2025: $365.66 / $326.34 / $978.42 / $2,287.07 (2025 proxy) vs $175.98 / $157.05 / $470.88 / $1,100.69 (2026 proxy); peer (Nasdaq 100) FY2025 $238.19 vs $168.46. The ratios match a plain rebase on the FY2021 value (2,287.07 / 207.79 x 100 = about 1,100.7). Every value is recorded as filed; the SCT totals and CAP figures for overlapping years are identical in all four proxies.

Rounding in the 2026 proxy SCT: for FY2026 the printed components of Huang (36,343,829), Kress (14,340,851), Puri (14,777,326) and Teter (14,276,383) differ by $1 from the printed totals (36,343,830, 14,340,850, 14,777,327, 14,276,382). Footnote (3) says numbers may not sum due to rounding. Totals are recorded as printed.

open_questions: Exact day Puri's title changed from EVP, Worldwide Sales to EVP, Worldwide Field Operations: only bounded by his Form 4s (2014-05-29 old title, 2014-09-17 new title). No 8-K covers it.

Puri's and Shoquist's start dates use Form 3 event dates (2005-12-22, 2007-09-17); the bios give only the month and no hire 8-K exists. Puri's Form 3 was filed the same day as its event date.
Huang's start is month precision (April 1993, the company's inception); no day is disclosed.

Puri left the officer ranks on 2026-08-24 but stays in a senior advisory role; how long he remains an employee, and his FY2027 pay, will first appear in the 2027 proxy (expected around May 2027). His successor Nicholas Parker (EVP, Worldwide Field Operations from 2026-08-24; $5,000,000 sign-on bonus and new-hire RSU/MY PSU grants with target values of $35,000,000 and $5,000,000 per the 8-K) is not an NEO in any filed SCT and is not included here.

coverage.method: Summary Compensation Tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-12, 2020-04-29, 2021-04-23, 2022-04-19, 2023-05-08, 2024-05-14, 2025-05-13, 2026-05-12). One comp row per (filing, NEO, fiscal year): 8 proxies x 5 NEOs x 3 years = 120 rows covering FY2017-FY2026. The NEO group is the same five people in every proxy. No NVIDIA SCT has Option Awards or Pension/NQDC columns, and from the 2022 proxy on there is no Bonus column (recorded as 0). Checked with no SCT: the 2022 'Notice of 2022 Annual Meeting' filed as form type DEF 14A (0001045810-22-000068), every DEFA14A (including the 2021-05-21 stock split supplement); no 10-K/A was filed in the period. The preliminary PRE 14As (2019-04-01, 2021-04-09, 2022-04-08, 2025-05-01) carry SCTs identical to the definitive filings and are not recorded separately. Fiscal years use NVIDIA's numbering: they end on the last Sunday in January and are named for the calendar year in which they end (c117); exact end dates in fiscal_year_ends come from each 10-K cover (FY2017 c107, FY2018 c108, FY2019 c109, FY2020 c110, FY2021 c111, FY2022 c112, FY2023 c113, FY2024 c114, FY2025 c115, FY2026 c116).
Every PvP table (2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 DEF 14A): 17 rows, one per (filing, fiscal year), Huang as the only PEO. The 2025 PRE 14A PvP table matches the definitive one.

For every NEO: the 1999 IPO prospectus (Huang), the executive officer rosters and bios in the 10-Ks for FY2006, FY2008, FY2009, FY2011 and FY2014-FY2026, the 2014 proxy (Kress start), every 8-K with Item 5.02 from 2013 through the feed's latest filing (2026-09-23), each NEO's Form 3, and Puri's Form 4 officer titles 2008-2015 and his 2026-08-24 retirement Form 4. Day precision comes from 8-K effective dates, the 2014 proxy, Form 3 event dates and Puri's Form 4 remark; promotions are month (or, for Puri's 2014 rename, year) precision from bios and Form 4 titles.
Only Huang was an NVIDIA executive officer among the NEOs before December 2005; earlier rosters (pre-FY2006 10-Ks) were not reviewed and non-NEO officers are not covered.
